Senior Backend Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our payments platform team. You will
design and operate the services that move billions of dollars a year.

Requirements
- 6+ years of experience building backend services in production
- Strong proficiency in Go or Java
- Deep experience with PostgreSQL and Redis
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Docker in production
- Experience designing and operating distributed systems
- Familiarity with Kafka or another event streaming platform
- Solid understanding of REST and gRPC API design
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code (Terraform)
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have
- Experience with AWS at scale
- Exposure to observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana
- Background in fintech or payments
- Experience mentoring engineers
- Familiarity with GraphQL

What you'll do
- Own the reliability and latency of core payment services
- Partner with product to ship customer-facing API endpoints
- Improve our deployment and testing practices
